items.title: How Much Further Could Vertiv Stock Fall?
items.summary: Vertiv (VRT) stock has lost about a quarter of its value over the past three months and now trades near $245. Its options price a range of $135 to $444 over roughly twelve months. The options market is not pricing panic, and the band is still very wide. For a holder, the width is the risk.

items.title: Vertiv Holdings Co (VRT) Shares Drop Into Securities Probe After Q2 Miss
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) is facing a shareholder investigation by law firm Hagens Berman over potential securities law violations. The probe follows a sharp post earnings drop in Vertiv's share price after Q2 results that the firm described as disappointing. Hagens Berman is reviewing whether Vertiv or its executives misled investors or failed to flag supply chain and project execution risks tied to the Q2 miss.
